name: Swing-level breakout
idea: A signal on the first close beyond the latest confirmed swing in the direction of the swing trend (a break of structure); the idea has ended when the structure breaks the other way against the trend.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the swing the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the break failed: the latest confirmed swing on the other side, or just beyond the broken swing. When it is not on the losing side of the close, there is no signal.

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken swing': how many average true ranges beyond it.
